summary_markdown:
The participants discussed data extraction and reporting tasks. Initially, [me] agreed to pull reach and impressions data, while [p1] would handle other tasks.

Later, [p1] provided guidance on calculating `faceWeight` for the second chart (viewed/viewable impressions), similar to how it was done in `demographics.queries`. This calculation requires knowing the number of faces within a facility and the campaign's assigned face count, though this parameter is not currently available in the payload but will be.

Finally, [p1] pointed out an issue with date ranges for `/api/campaigns/report/charts`, noting that while the `from-date` in the payload might be set (e.g., 2023-09-01), the actual data returned starts one day later (e.g., 2023-09-02). [me] acknowledged this and committed to fixing it.
decisions: The calculation of `faceWeight` for viewed/viewable impressions was defined, requiring facility face count and campaign face count.
action_items: [me] will fix the date range issue for `/api/campaigns/report/charts` so that data starts on the specified `from-date`.
